desc: The Breek-LOK 3QD Scorch 3-Prong Flash Hider minimizes muzzle flash by dispersing and redirecting gases, aided by internal threads that enhance suppression beyond standard hiders. This reduces flash, preserves a clear sight picture, and prevents temporary blindness in low-light conditions. The prongs’ varying slot lengths eliminate the “ping” sound common with tine-style flash hiders, while the low-profile design maintains a clean, streamlined appearance.
